chapters.n: John “the elder” writes a personal note to Gaius, a beloved friend and faithful member, whom he loves in the truth.

f.g: A common Roman name; this Gaius is otherwise unknown.

chapters.n: John wishes Gaius good health and success in all things, just as his soul is thriving.

f.g: Have things go well along the way.

chapters.n: Traveling believers reported Gaius’s faithfulness, and John was delighted to hear how he lives the truth.
A line many parents and teachers feel deeply: nothing brings John greater joy than hearing that his spiritual children are living the truth.
Gaius faithfully serves fellow believers, even traveling ones he had never met.
These travelers have told the church about his love. John urges Gaius to send them on their way supplied in a manner worthy of God.

f.g: Help them on their way with food, money, and supplies.

chapters.n: These missionaries went out for Christ’s name and refused support from unbelievers.

f.g: Accepting no support from pagans, so their message wasn’t seen as a money-making scheme.

chapters.n: So believers should support such workers and become partners in spreading the truth.
John had written to the congregation, but Diotrephes, who loves being in charge, refuses to recognize John’s authority.
If John comes, he will address Diotrephes’s behavior: spreading malicious gossip, refusing to host missionaries, stopping others who want to, and expelling them from the church.
Don’t imitate evil, but imitate good. Doing good shows you belong to God; doing evil shows you haven’t truly seen Him.

f.w: follow not that which is evil

chapters.n: Demetrius, perhaps the one carrying this letter, has a good reputation with everyone and with the truth itself. John adds his own endorsement.

f.g: Possibly the letter’s carrier; otherwise unknown.

chapters.n: As in 2 John, he has more to say but doesn’t want to write it all with ink and pen.
He hopes to see Gaius soon and talk face to face. He closes with peace and greetings from friends, asking Gaius to greet each friend by name.
